editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: openinterpreter/openinterpreter
items.summary: Open Interpreter offers a coding agent that automates software development processes by running code in the local computer environment. Designed to work with low-cost language models, this tool allows executing complex tasks directly from the terminal.

items.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
items.summary: DeepTutor is a lifelong learning-based private tutoring system that offers personalized education processes using student data. The project aims to optimize the learning experience with artificial intelligence-supported individualized tutoring methods.

items.title: YimMenu/YimMenuV2
items.summary: YimMenuV2 is an experimental menu modification developed for Grand Theft Auto 5: Enhanced edition. Written in C++, this tool offers various customizations and extended functions within the game.

items.title: Inkling: Our Open-Weights Model
items.summary: Published by Thinking Machines, Inkling is offered to developers as an open-weighted language model. The model aims for a flexible structure that allows fine-tuning on special data sets.

items.title: Stripe and Advent have made a joint offer to acquire PayPal – sources
items.summary: Stripe and investment firm Advent have made a joint bid worth more than $53 billion to acquire payment systems provider PayPal. This initiative reflects trends of large-scale consolidation in the financial technology (fintech) sector.

items.title: Grok Build is open source
items.summary: xAI has published the Grok-1 open source library, which is based on the architecture and training processes of the Grok model. This development allows developers to fine-tune large language models and examine the working principles of the model.

items.title: Running Gemma 4 26B at 5 tokens/sec on a 13-year-old Xeon with no GPU
items.summary: The Gemma 4 26B model can be run at a speed of 5 tokens per second on a 13-year-old Xeon processor without using a graphics processing unit (GPU). This application demonstrates the importance of optimization techniques for efficient inference of large language models (LLM) on older hardware.

items.title: SQLite should have (Rust-style) editions
items.summary: A structure similar to the editions model in Rust is recommended for the SQLite database engine. This approach aims to add new features and improve the long-term maintenance processes of the software without disrupting backward compatibility.

items.title: prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-27B-gguf
items.summary: Ternary-Bonsai-27B is offered as a text-generation model optimized with the ternary quantization method. This technique aims to reduce memory usage while minimizing the performance loss of the model.

items.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling
items.summary: Developed by Thinkingmachines, Inkling is a multimodal model that produces text output by processing visual and text inputs. The system is designed to analyze visual data and use it in text-based tasks.

items.title: prism-ml/Bonsai-27B-gguf
items.summary: Bonsai-27B is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. This structure, presented in GGUF format, allows the model to run more efficiently on different hardware resources.
